name: @creepiest-space/create-project
description: Create a Creepiest Space Bun and TypeScript project

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/cli.ts ./src/index.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist && bunx tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run build && publint && bun run verify:types && bun run verify:tarball
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run verify:package
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
